```java
/** 
 * Unsubscribe for presence change events for specified contact.
 * @param contact contact instance
 * @throws IllegalStateException if disconnected
 * @throws OperationFailedException if something went wrong
 */
@Override public void unsubscribe(final Contact contact) throws IllegalStateException, OperationFailedException {
  if (contact == null) {
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("contact cannot be null");
  }
  final IrcConnection connection=this.parentProvider.getIrcStack().getConnection();
  if (connection == null) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    connection.getPresenceManager().removeNickWatch(contact.getAddress());
  } catch (UnsupportedOperationException e) {
    throw new OperationFailedException("Failed to unsubscribe", e);
  }
}
```
